hostname rt-q01
!
vrf definition cust-a
 address-family ipv4
 exit-address-family
!
crypto keyring KR-SAMPLE-VT
 pre-shared-key address 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 key dummy-psk-sample-vt
!
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encryption aes 256
 hash sha256
 authentication pre-share
 group 14
crypto isakmp key dummy-psk-sample-name hostname rt-q09.example.com
crypto isakmp key dummy-psk-sample-c address 203.0.113.40
!
crypto isakmp profile ISAKMP-SAMPLE-VT
 keyring KR-SAMPLE-VT
 match identity address 0.0.0.0
 virtual-template 1
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-SAMPLE esp-aes 256 esp-sha256-hmac
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-SAMPLE-VT
 set transform-set TS-SAMPLE
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-SAMPLE
 set transform-set TS-SAMPLE
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample-wan
 ip address 203.0.113.9 255.255.255.248
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample-lan
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.128
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 description sample-lan-cust-a
 vrf forwarding cust-a
 ip address 192.0.2.129 255.255.255.128
!
interface Tunnel1
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel destination rt-q09.example.com
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-SAMPLE
!
interface Tunnel2
 vrf forwarding cust-a
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/2
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel destination 203.0.113.40
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-SAMPLE
!
interface Virtual-Template1 type tunnel
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-SAMPLE-VT
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.14
ip route 198.51.100.128 255.255.255.128 Tunnel1
ip route vrf cust-a 198.51.100.0 255.255.255.128 Tunnel2
!
end
